description: Anti-slop house style gate. After any Write or Edit, runs the voice linter at ${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}/../anti-slop-brain/scripts/lint_voice.py over the file that was just written. On a house style violation it exits 2, which blocks and feeds the linter output back for self-correction. It is installed and removed with this plugin and it never writes to any global or project settings file, but it is NOT skill-gated and its effect is not confined to this project: the matcher is Write|Edit with no condition on which skill is active, so while the plugin is installed it fires on every Write and Edit in every session and every repository, including ones unrelated to this project. See SECURITY.md, and hooks/README.md for exit codes, failure behaviour and environment.

hooks.command: python3 -c "import json,os,subprocess,sys; d=json.load(sys.stdin); p=(d.get('tool_input') or {}).get('file_path') or ''; s=os.path.join(os.environ.get('CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT',''),'..','anti-slop-brain','scripts','lint_voice.py'); r=(subprocess.run([sys.executable,s,p],capture_output=True,text=True) if (p and os.path.isfile(p) and os.path.isfile(s)) else None); bad=bool(r) and r.returncode!=0; sys.stderr.write((r.stdout+r.stderr) if bad else ''); sys.exit(2 if bad else 0)"
